energy-conservation.def: Using less energy, usually by changing behavior, such as turning off lights, lowering the thermostat or driving less.

energy-efficiency.def: Getting the same service with less energy, such as LED bulbs, insulation or appliances and cars that use less energy for the same work.

hybrid-vehicle.def: A vehicle that pairs a gasoline engine with an electric motor and battery, recapturing braking energy to use less fuel; an electric vehicle runs on a battery alone.
